title: Checkout redesign workshop — client alignment
content: Client confirmed guest checkout is the launch priority. Express payments (Apple Pay, PayPal) move to phase 2. Decision: keep the OMS integration synchronous for order placement, async for status updates. Loyalty points display in cart deferred pending legal review of the points-as-tender question.

title: Search & discovery discovery call
content: Einstein search stays; no third-party search vendor this year. Category landing pages will be CMS-driven via Page Designer. Client wants faceted navigation parity with the legacy site before any redesign of the PLP. Analytics events must fire on facet selection.

title: ACME-1042: Guest checkout — address validation fails for BFPO addresses
content: Address validation service rejects BFPO and PO-box formats. Agreed fix: bypass strict validation when the country selector is GB and the postcode matches the BFPO pattern; flag the order for manual review instead of blocking placement. Acceptance: Playwright spec covers BFPO happy path and manual-review flag.

title: ACME-1077: PDP performance budget exceeded on image-heavy products
content: LCP over 4s on products with more than 8 gallery images. Decision from performance review: serve gallery thumbnails via the image service with explicit width params, lazy-load below-the-fold images, and cap preloaded hero variants to two. Target LCP under 2.5s on mid-tier mobile.

title: Storefront Next conventions — routes, loaders, and data flow
content: All data access happens in route loaders and actions; components are presentational. Forms must work without JavaScript (progressive enhancement). Shared UI lives in app/components with one directory per component. New dependencies require an architecture decision record approved by the tech lead.

title: Release process — environments and cadence
content: Weekly release train from main to staging on Wednesdays, production on Mondays after client sign-off. Hotfixes branch from the last production tag. Every release candidate runs the full Playwright suite against staging; a red suite blocks the train, no exceptions.
